reference_sql:
WITH cohort AS (  -- one row per account created in the cohort months
  SELECT account_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM accounts
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
),
active AS (  -- one row per cohort account and month with a usage week
  SELECT DISTINCT c.account_id, c.cohort_month,
         date_diff('month', c.cohort_month, CAST(date_trunc('month', w.week_start) AS DATE)) AS month_offset
  FROM cohort c
  JOIN usage_weekly w ON w.account_id = c.account_id
),
months AS (  -- one row per cohort month
  SELECT DISTINCT cohort_month
  FROM cohort
)
SELECT m.cohort_month, k.month_offset,
       CASE WHEN m.cohort_month + INTERVAL (k.month_offset) MONTH >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL
            ELSE COUNT(a.account_id) END AS active_accounts
FROM months m
CROSS JOIN range(0, 4) AS k(month_offset)
LEFT JOIN active a ON a.cohort_month = m.cohort_month AND a.month_offset = k.month_offset
GROUP BY m.cohort_month, k.month_offset

WITH cohort AS (  -- one row per account created in the cohort months
  SELECT account_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS cohort_month
  FROM accounts
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
),
grid AS (  -- one row per cohort month and month offset from 0 to 3
  SELECT DISTINCT c.cohort_month, k.month_offset
  FROM cohort c
  CROSS JOIN generate_series(0, 3) AS k(month_offset)
)
SELECT g.cohort_month, g.month_offset,
       CASE WHEN date_diff('month', g.cohort_month, DATE '2026-01-01') <= g.month_offset THEN NULL
            ELSE (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.account_id)
                  FROM cohort c
                  JOIN usage_weekly w ON w.account_id = c.account_id
                  WHERE c.cohort_month = g.cohort_month
                    AND date_diff('month', c.cohort_month, w.week_start) = g.month_offset) END AS active_accounts
FROM grid g

            ELSE (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.account_id)
                  FROM cohort c

solver.query:
WITH c AS (
  SELECT account_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', created_at) AS DATE) AS cm FROM accounts
  WHERE created_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AND created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
),
a AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT account_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', week_start) AS DATE) AS wm FROM usage_weekly
),
cells AS (
  SELECT d.cm, k.month_offset, CAST(d.cm + to_months(CAST(k.month_offset AS INTEGER)) AS DATE) AS mstart
  FROM (SELECT DISTINCT cm FROM c) d CROSS JOIN range(0, 4) AS k(month_offset)
)
SELECT x.cm AS cohort_month, x.month_offset,
       CASE WHEN x.mstart >= DATE '2026-01-01' THEN NULL ELSE COUNT(a.account_id) END AS active_accounts
FROM cells x
JOIN c ON c.cm = x.cm
LEFT JOIN a ON a.account_id = c.account_id AND a.wm = x.mstart
GROUP BY x.cm, x.month_offset, x.mstart
